title: AppRoute
summary: A flat application route with optional metadata and lazy-module integration.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Extends Route with id, routePath, meta, preload, and resolveComponent. path is the pattern matched by the router. Explicit id and the legacy routePath override apply only to manually defined arrays. File routes derive identity and paths from filenames and reject those exports; use [.] for literal dots.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: File-router helpers populate lazy-module hooks. Do not hand-code preload or resolveComponent unless providing your own lazy integration. A route without a default component can act as a resource route on the server.
